an7.52:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggārāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an7.52:1.2: atha kho sambahulā campeyyakā upāsakā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho campeyyakā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an7.52:1.3: cirassutā no bhante sāriputta, bhagavato sammukhā dhammīkathā.
an7.52:1.4: sādhu mayaṃ bhante, labheyyāma bhagavato santikā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savaṇāyāti.
an7.52:1.6: appevanāma labheyyātha bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savaṇāyāti.
an7.52:1.7: evaṃ bhanteti kho te campeyyakā upāsakā āyasmato sāriputtassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā ayasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
an7.52:2.1: atha kho te campeyyakā upāsakā tadahuposathe yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
an7.52:2.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto tehi campeyyakehi upāsakehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an7.52:3.1: siyā nu kho bhante, idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ.
an7.52:3.2: siyā pana bhante, idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.52:3.3: siyā sāriputta, idhekaccassa tādisaṃ yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ.
an7.52:3.4: siyā pana sāriputta, idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.52:3.5: ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti, na mahānisaṃsaṃ.
an7.52:3.6: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti? (1)
an7.52:4.1: idha sāriputta, ekacco sāpekho dānaṃ deti, paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti, sannidhipekho dānaṃ deti, imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:4.2: so taṃ dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā, annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyā sathapadīpeyyaṃ.
an7.52:4.3: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sāriputta, dadeyya idhekacco evarūpaṃ dānanti.
an7.52:5.1: tatra sāriputta, yvāyaṃ sāpekho dānaṃ deti, paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti, sannidhipekho dānaṃ deti, imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:5.2: so taṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an7.52:5.3: so taṃ kammaṃ khepetvā taṃ iddhiṃ taṃ yasaṃ taṃ ādhipateyyaṃ āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ. (2)
an7.52:6.1: idha pana sāriputta, ekacco na heva kho sāpekho dānaṃ deti, na paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti, na sannidhipekho dānaṃ deti, na imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:6.2: api ca kho sāhu dānanti dānaṃ deti. …pe… (3)
an7.52:7.2: api ca kho dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, nārahāmi porāṇaṃkulavaṃsaṃ hāpetunti dānaṃ deti …pe… (4)
an7.52:8.1: napi dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, nārahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetunti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:8.2: api ca kho ahaṃ pacāmi, na ime pacanti, nārahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ adātunti dānaṃ deti …pe… (5)
an7.52:9.1: napi ahaṃ pacāmi ime na pacanti, nārahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātunti dānaṃ deti …pe…
an7.52:9.2: api ca kho yathā tesaṃ pubbakānaṃ isīnaṃ tāni mahāyaññāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.52:9.3: aṭṭakassa vāmakassa vāmadevassa vessāmittassa yamataggino aṅgīrasassa bhāradvājassa vāseṭṭhassa kassapassa bhaguno, evaṃ me ayaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgo bhavissatīti dānaṃ deti …pe… (6)
an7.52:10.1: napi yathā tesaṃ pubbakānaṃ isīnaṃ tāni mahāyaññāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.52:10.2: aṭṭakassa vāmakassa vāmadevassa vessāmittassa yamataggino aṅgīrasassa bhāradvājassa vāseṭṭhassa kassapassa bhaguno, evaṃ me ayaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgo bhavissatīti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:10.3: api ca kho imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanatā somanassaṃ upajāyatīti dānaṃ deti …pe… (7)
an7.52:11.1: napi imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanā somanassaṃ upajāyatīti dānaṃ deti,
an7.52:11.2: api ca kho cittālaṃkāraṃ cittaparikkhāranti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:11.3: so taṃ dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā, annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.
an7.52:11.4: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sāriputta, dadeyya idhekacco evarūpaṃ dānanti,
an7.52:12.1: tatra sāriputta, yvāyaṃ na heva kho sāpekho dānaṃ deti -
an7.52:12.4: na imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti -
an7.52:12.6: napi dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi, nārahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetunti dānaṃ deti -
an7.52:12.7: napi ahā pacāmi ime na pacanti nārahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātunti dānaṃ deti -
an7.52:12.8: napi yathā tesaṃ pubbakānaṃ isīnaṃ tāni mahāyattāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.52:12.9: aṭṭakassa vāmakassa vāmadevassa vessāmittassa yamataggino aṅgīrasassa bhāradvājassa vāseṭṭhassa kassapassa bhaguno, evaṃ me ayaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgo bhavissatīti dānaṃ deti -
an7.52:12.10: napi imaṃ me dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdati, attamanatā somanassaṃ upajāyatīti dānaṃ deti -
an7.52:12.11: api ca kho cittālaṃkāraṃ cittaparikkhāranti dānaṃ deti.
an7.52:12.12: so taṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an7.52:12.13: so taṃ kammaṃ khepetvā taṃ iddhiṃ taṃ yasaṃ taṃ ādhipateyyaṃ anāgāmī hoti anāgantā itthattaṃ.
an7.52:13.1: ayaṃ kho sāriputta hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti, na mahānisaṃsaṃ.
an7.52:13.2: ayaṃ pana sāriputta, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekaccassa tādisaṃ - yeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsanti.
